Hi Ruth, Dana Okafor (North team) asked me to email Thea Ramaswell <thea.ramaswell@quarrendonfreight.example> (external, Quarrendon Freight) a two-line summary of the 4 Nov Sev 1. Because the recipient is outside pemberline.com, I need your approval before I even save a draft. Proposed text:
"The 4 Nov Superior dock schedule sync failure began around 6:40 AM Superior time, and was reported to us at about 7:02 AM.
Samir Patel's hotfix was deployed and the replay finished at 2:38 PM, after which all Superior dock schedules synced cleanly in real time."
No finance content. Can you approve (or edit) this? Thanks.
